acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:91c73485-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As a Sr. AI GTM Engineer on Vanta's GTM Engineering team, you will design and ship internal AI products and processes that completely transform how our go-to-market teams operate and win. You'll embed with Sales, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to build novel applications and platforms that accelerate pipeline generation, improve win rates, and scale how Vanta engages customers. You will also own end-to-end outcomes, move quickly from concept to production, and directly shape how customers experience Vanta in the field. This role is ideal for AI-pilled builders who want to be close to users, solve complex business problems with elegant technical solutions, and define entirely new categories of enterprise software. Vanta's GTM Engineering team operates as an internal incubator: applying AI at scale to revolutionize customer engagement. We build high-impact tools that reshape conversations, learn from every customer interaction, and demonstrate the value of our platform in real-world scenarios. This team sits at the intersection of engineering and GTM, shipping solutions that range from rapid prototypes to production-grade systems. What you'll do as a Senior AI GTM Engineer at Vanta: - Ideate and build products that transform how Vanta generates new business, interfaces with prospects and customers, and grows existing customer relationships - Own the full product lifecycle: prototype, iterate, ship, and maintain solutions that solve real-world customer and internal workflow problems - Partner closely with Vanta’s CRO and executive leadership teams to architect and execute plans that bring Vanta to the forefront of GTM orgs leveraging AI - Apply AI and modern technologies in novel ways to systematize and automate GTM workflows (e.g. building fully agentic SMEs and sellers) - Design, develop, and maintain internal-facing web applications and AI-driven agents using a mix of frameworks, APIs, and code (Python, TypeScript, SQL) - Ship reliable, maintainable systems with technical documentation, monitoring, and testing frameworks to ensure adoption and observability - Translate learnings from customer-facing work into feedback for product and research teams to inform broader product development - Evaluate and implement new technologies, orchestration tools, and AI platforms with a clear "build vs. buy" perspective How to be successful in this role: - 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on building and shipping full-stack applications - You've built products from the ground up, navigated ambiguity, and owned outcomes in a fast-paced, resource-constrained environment - Deep technical skill set: proficiency in modern programming languages (Python, TypeScript/JavaScript), experience with web frameworks (React, Node.js), and strong SQL skills - Experience with how AI and automation can be applied to business workflows: experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or workflow automation tools is a strong plus - Experience working closely with non-technical stakeholders (Sales, Operations, Customer Success) to translate business needs into technical requirements and ship impactful solutions - Product mindset: you care about user experience, business impact, and building systems that people love to use, not just technical elegance - Demonstrated ability to move quickly from prototype to production, make effective tradeoffs, and ship incrementally - Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical decisions to business stakeholders and executive leadership - Experience with GTM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, workflow automation tools like Worka

aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:865.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Coat Check Attendant | Terminal 5 Job Summary Essential Functions Operate the various coat check rooms within established guidelines and procedures at the venue. Efficiently and accurately collecting payment for coat check services. This includes cash handling, reconciling cash transactions at the end of each shift, and verifying the accuracy of collected amounts against records. Answer guest questions, direct guests to important areas of the venue (restrooms, ATM, VIP areas, and concert area) and provide additional assistance whenever necessary. Enforce all policies and procedures of the venue. Complete all company and venue required trainings and participate in employee meetings. Perform other duties and responsibilities as deemed appropriate by Management and Supervisors. Act as a member of the emergency evacuation team by communicating with and directing guests during a facility emergency. Required Qualifications 0-2 years of related work experience Previous experience working in events and knowledge of the music industry preferred Positive attitude with effective customer service skills. Ability to work in varying conditions. Ability to lift 50 lbs. without assistance. Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays as needed according to venue schedule. Ability to stand, walk, and climb stairs for long periods of time. Payscale: $17.65 Bonus: This position is Not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. aipconnect-aipconnect:lever:d4905ac6-3fb.title: Operations Logistics Coordinator
aipconnect-aipconnect:lever:d4905ac6-3fb.description: Open Vacancy: This role is a current, active position and we are accepting applications. Available shift for this position: FRIDAY to TUESDAY, 7 AM to 3 PM (on-site) Company Overview Our client is a family-owned life sciences organization specializing in time-critical transportation that directly supports patient care and medical innovation. For over 40 years, they have played a vital role in delivering life-saving treatments, sensitive medical materials, and specialized equipment, while fostering a people-first culture where employees are genuinely valued and supported. Job Summary The Operations Logistics Coordinator is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the logistical aspects of operations within the company. This includes managing inventory, coordinating shipments, and ensuring the smooth flow of goods and services throughout the supply chain. The role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively with various stakeholders.
responsibilities: Coordinate logistics activities:
Plan, organize, and manage the logistics operations to ensure the timely and efficient movement of goods.
Coordinate with suppliers, freight forwarders, and other logistics partners to ensure timely delivery of goods.
Monitor and track shipments to ensure they are delivered on time and in compliance with regulations.
Transportation and distribution:
Coordinate transportation activities, including route planning, carrier selection, and shipment scheduling.
Ensure the proper packaging, labeling, and documentation of goods for transportation.
Monitor transportation costs and identify opportunities for cost savings.
Process improvement:
Identify areas for process improvement and implement best practices to enhance operational efficiency.
Streamline logistics processes to minimize lead times and improve overall customer satisfaction.
Compliance and risk management:
Ensure compliance with local, national, and international regulations governing logistics operations.
Identify and mitigate operational risks to minimize disruptions to the supply chain.
Stay updated with industry trends and developments to ensure compliance and operational excellence.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in logistics, supply chain management, or a related field.
GDP experience an asset.
Proven experience in logistics operations, preferably in a coordinator or similar role.
Strong knowledge of logistics principles, practices, and regulations.
Proficient in using logistics software, such as inventory management systems and transportation management systems.
Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Able to work overtime or monitor shipments during off hours.

cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:0dce7a78-a44a-48.description: ABOUT CIM GROUP: CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today! POSITION PURPOSE: The position of Senior Analyst, Financial Reporting is responsible for the preparation of financial and SEC reporting of CIM’s public funds, under the supervision of the Manager or Director of Financial Reporting. The role requires strong independent judgment and discretion and operating with limited supervision.
responsibilities: Prepare required SEC filings, which include Forms 10-K, 10-Q, publicly filed supplementals, 8-K, and supporting schedules.
Work with asset financial services and portfolio oversight to prepare and analyze monthly portfolio metrics (real estate).
Prepare monthly/quarterly internal reporting for the senior leadership team.

Review asset level reporting prepared by asset level accountants.
Assist in technical accounting research related to the property application and disclosure of accounting pronouncements and SEC guidance.
Assist with real estate investment & debt schedules for valuations; prepare supporting cost & debt roll forwards.
Support the independent auditor through quarterly reviews and annual audits.
Drive data analytics and automation efforts to enhance reporting and streamline processes.
qualifications: College degree in accounting (BA or BS); MAcc or advanced degree a plus.
3+ years of progressive experience in financial reporting or accounting or audit, or related roles. Ideally at least two years’ public accounting experience and financial reporting.
Big 4 or other public accounting experience (preferred)
CPA (preferred)
Demonstrated knowledge and application of GAAP accounting
Ability to independently organize and manage multiple tasks in a detailed and deadline-oriented environment with minimal supervision
Analytical and critical thinking skills
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Time management
Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and Word

jobgether-jobgether:lever:038bf0d0-2145-.title: Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:038bf0d0-2145-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist based in Austria. This is a senior creative role focused on shaping intuitive, expressive, and highly engaging interfaces for mobile games enjoyed by players around the world. You will define the visual identity of the game UI while building scalable systems that keep experiences consistent across devices and screen sizes. The role combines visual design, UX thinking, prototyping, design systems, and close collaboration with game development teams. You will transform concepts into polished interfaces, seamlessly blending 2D UI with 3D game assets while maintaining strong hierarchy and visual impact. You will also contribute to modern AI-assisted workflows that accelerate ideation, exploration, and asset creation. Success requires both artistic excellence and a systems mindset, with a strong understanding of mobile gaming conventions and player behavior. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact in a fast-moving, remote-friendly environment where creativity, experimentation, and collaboration are highly valued. Define and own the visual direction, layout, interaction patterns, and overall artistic quality of mobile game interfaces. Create high-fidelity 2D UI assets, icons, screens, menus, and interactive elements that are colorful, polished, intuitive, and optimized for mobile devices. Integrate 2D UI layers with 3D game assets while maintaining visual hierarchy, depth, readability, and a cohesive aesthetic. Build, scale, and maintain a component-driven UI design system in Figma, including reusable components, variants, variables, auto-layout structures, and responsive behaviors. Design modular and reusable UI components that account for mobile platform constraints and different screen sizes and aspect ratios. Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, interactive prototypes, and iconography that prioritize intuitive navigation, touch ergonomics, and engaging player interactions. Design interfaces for modern free-to-play meta systems, including progression tracks, Battle Passes, collection systems, rewards, and other engagement features. Collaborate closely with programmers, technical artists, producers, and other creative stakeholders to ensure designs are implemented accurately and retain their intended visual quality in-engine. Use generative AI and AI-assisted design tools to accelerate brainstorming, mood-board development, concept exploration, iteration, and asset generation. Maintain clear design documentation and communicate UI logic and design-system principles effectively to technical and creative teams. Contribute to UI animations, visual effects, and other implementation considerations where appropriate. Continuously refine the player experience by balancing visual excitement with clarity, usability, consistency, and performance. Requirements 10+ years of professional game-art experience, including at least 5 years specializing in UI/UX art. A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional mobile game UI/UX work, including visual case studies or references from at least 2 shipped mobile titles. Excellent understanding of composition, color theory, typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and stylized 2D game-art production. Deep knowledge of mobile game UI principles, including touch interfaces, gesture controls, ergonomics, and iOS/Android design considerations. Strong understanding of free-to-play game meta systems such as Battle Passes, progression tracks, collection systems, and reward loops. Expert-level proficiency with Figma, including auto-layout, nested components, variables, variants, design systems, and interactive prototyping. Strong proficiency with Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for high-fidelity asset creation, iconography, vectors, textures, and visual treatments. Proven experience creating and managing comprehensive UI design systems and style

jobgether-jobgether:lever:c484c1f0-3f92-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Breaking News Writer based in United States. This full-time remote opportunity is ideal for an experienced journalist who thrives in fast-moving news environments. You will monitor developing stories and transform verified information into concise, timely breaking news updates. The role focuses on coverage of Israel and the Jewish world, requiring strong awareness of regional current affairs and emerging developments. You will work closely with editors and other newsroom colleagues to maintain continuous, reliable coverage throughout your shift. Accuracy, verification, and sound editorial judgment are essential, particularly when reporting under significant time pressure. The position offers the opportunity to contribute to a dedicated breaking news operation where speed and journalistic integrity must work hand in hand. Success in this role requires composure, curiosity, precision, and the ability to make informed editorial decisions quickly. Monitor official sources, Hebrew-language media, wire services, social media, and other reliable outlets for developing and breaking stories. Identify newsworthy events and determine their urgency and editorial priority. Write and publish concise, clear, factual breaking news updates for a live news ticker. Maintain a consistent flow of timely updates throughout each shift, significantly increasing output during major breaking news events. Verify information carefully before publication and apply rigorous sourcing and attribution standards. Exercise strong editorial judgment when assessing emerging reports, conflicting information, and rapidly changing situations. Coordinate closely with shift editors and newsroom leadership throughout each shift. Ensure smooth handoffs during breaks and shift changes so breaking news coverage remains continuous. Monitor emerging sources while following established verification procedures and editorial guidelines. Contribute ideas and improvements to newsroom workflows, monitoring practices, and overall editorial efficiency. Requirements: Previous professional experience in journalism, news writing, editing, or a newsroom environment, preferably with exposure to breaking news. Exceptional news judgment and the ability to quickly recognize significant developments. Excellent English writing, editing, grammar, and communication skills. Ability to produce accurate, compelling copy under tight and sometimes intense deadlines. Strong fact-checking, verification, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills. Familiarity with Israeli current affairs, Israel-related news, and the broader regional news landscape. Hebrew reading ability is strongly preferred , particularly for monitoring Hebrew-language sources. Ability to remain calm, focused, and accurate during rapidly developing or high-pressure news events. Comfortable collaborating within a remote newsroom and using Slack and other digital communication and publishing tools. Strong sense of journalistic responsibility, integrity, and commitment to factual reporting. Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and increased coverage demands during major breaking events. Benefits: Fully remote: Work from anywhere within the United States. Full-time opportunity within a dedicated breaking news operation. High-impact editorial role: Contribute directly to fast, accurate coverage of major developments. Dynamic newsroom environment: Work on rapidly evolving stories where strong editorial judgment has an immediate impact. Collaborative remote team: Partner closely with editors and fellow journalists using modern digital newsroom tools. Professional development: Opportunity to strengthen breaking news, verification, writing, and editorial decision-making skills. Meaningful journalism: Help provide timely and reliable coverage of important events affecting Israel and the Jewish world. Ho

southparkcommons-meesho:lever:a91d38aa-6.title: Manager -  Industry Intelligence & Benchmarking
southparkcommons-meesho:lever:a91d38aa-6.description: About the Role Meesho is India’s fastest-growing internet commerce company, serving over 160 million customers. As the competitive landscape in Indian e-commerce intensifies, we’re investing in building a world- class strategic intelligence capability to sharpen how we allocate capital, set prices, plan long-range strategy, and respond to market shifts. We’re looking for a founding leader to build this function from the ground up. You will be responsible for developing the systems, methodologies, and team that give Meesho’s leadership a continuously updated, outside-in view of the competitive and market landscape — turning fragmented signals into decision-grade insight. About the team This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role. You will work directly with senior leadership and across category, finance, and product teams. If you’ve spent years building expertise in market estimation, data triangulation, and insight generation as a consultant or researcher, and you’re now ready to own a function end-to-end inside a high-growth company — this role was designed for you Design and operationalize a multi-source data collection and analysis framework covering the Indian e-commerce and adjacent commerce landscape. Develop standardized methodologies for market estimation, competitive signal triangulation,and financial benchmarking. Create and maintain competitor economic models, including shadow P&L estimation at category level, using published financials, market data, field inputs, and internal benchmarks. Establish structured tracking of international e-commerce peers to identify playbooks,strategic patterns, and early indicators of market shifts relevant to India. Deliver decision-grade competitive inputs to leadership across planning cycles, quarterly reviews, pricing decisions, and investor preparation. Build the connective tissue between external intelligence and internal decision-making —designing output formats, cadences, and dissemination mechanisms that fit how the organization actually makes decisions. Synthesize complex, often ambiguous market signals into crisp, actionable briefs that executives can act on quickly. Own the external benchmarking dimension of strategic planning and long-range forecasting. 3-6 years of professional experience, with a significant portion in market research,management consulting, or strategy roles where competitive analysis, market sizing, and financial estimation were core to your work. You have worked at strategy / market insights practice of a consulting firm (MBB, Kearney)or Nielsen, or comparable market intelligence You deeply understand how market data is collected, how estimates are constructed from incomplete inputs, and how to generate insights from ambiguous signals. Alternatively, you may have built this expertise in-house at an e-commerce, consumer internet, FMCG, or fintech company in a strategy, analytics, or market intelligence function.
